# LEO SNOW

> LEO SNOW — "Ghana Boy With A Different Flow" and "The Storm From Africa" — is an Afrobeats artist from Ghana blending afrobeats, alté and street soul into one cold wave.

The official site is a dark, cinematic multi-page experience: a scroll-zoom hero, the artist's story, a showcase room of visual moments, music releases with streaming links, tour events with ticket and calendar links, a full discography page, an about page with socials, and a booking contact form. Content is managed live through a connected Supabase backend.

## Pages

- [Home](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/): full-screen hero with the LEO SNOW brand, tagline "Ghana Boy With A Different Flow", and a Stream Latest button.
- [Music (full discography)](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/music.html): every release with cover art, type and year, each with a Stream toggle for its platforms.
- [About](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/about.html): the full artist bio, portrait, and a "Follow The Storm" section linking every social platform.
- [Contact](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/contact.html): bookings and inquiries by email and a direct message form, plus socials.
- [Merch](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/merch.html): the official store (launching soon).
- [Terms](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/terms.html) and [Privacy](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/privacy.html): site policies.

## Home page sections

- [Music](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#music): releases (singles, EPs, mixtapes) with cover art and direct links to streaming platforms (Spotify, Audiomack, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Boomplay, Deezer).
- [Videos](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#videos): official music videos embedded from YouTube.
- [Events](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#shows): upcoming shows with dates, cities, ticket links and add-to-calendar reminders.
- [About](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#about): the artist's story and a showcase room of images, each with its own story.
- [Booking](https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/#contact): bookings and inquiries via email and a direct message form.

## Contact

- Bookings: leosnowbookings@gmail.com
- Streaming: available on YouTube, SoundCloud, Apple Music and Audiomack
